subject: classical-civilisation-ocr
title: Myth as a Symbol of Power
reason: Presenting the Persian Wars allegorical reading as transparent rather than qualifying it as a modern scholarly interpretation is standard teaching at GCSE Classical Civilisation and would not cause a student to lose marks.

pedantry.quote: To any educated Greek approaching the Parthenon, this wasn't just a fun monster story... The Lapiths represented Athens... The Centaurs... represented barbarism, disorder, and very specifically, the Persians.
